senses.gloss: वेश, वेश्य, &c. See s. v.

वेश वेश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. विश्), entrance,
[]
ingress, access; a house, dwelling, abode; a house of
prostitutes; a neighbour (Ved., Sāy. = प्रतिवेश्य, Ṛg-
veda IV. 3, 13); dress, apparel; ornament, decora-
tion [cf. वेष]; disguise, masquerade; [cf. Gr.
οἶκο-ς, οἰκά-α; Lat. vicu-s, vic-inu-s; Goth. veihs;
Angl. Sax. wic.]
—वेश-दान, अस्, m. the sunflower
(= सूर्य-शोभा).
—वेश-धारिन्, ई, m. ‘wearing a
disguise,’ a hypocrite, false devotee.
—वेश-भृत्, त्,
त्, त्, wearing dress or ornament, dressed, adorned;
disguised.
—वेश-वाट, अम्, n. house and court.

वेष वेष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. विष्), dress, ap-
parel [cf. वेश]; ornament, decoration; (in Naigh.
II. 1. वेषः, or according to another reading वेशः,
is enumerated among the कर्म-नामानि.)
वेश् वेश्. See under rt. 1. वेस्, p. 967.

2. वेस्, Ved. in the phrase वेर् न, ‘like a bird;’
[cf. 2. वि.]

वेशक, अस्, आ or इका, अम्, who or what enters, en-
tering; (अस्), m. a house; (इका), f. entrance, ingress.
वेशन, अम्, n. the act of entering; a house.

वेसन, अम्, n. a kind of flour made from a par-
ticular ground vegetable (= द्विदल-चूर्ण).

वेशन्त, अस्, m. a basin, pool, small pond; a kind
of ladle or basin for holding Soma (Ved., cf. वै-
शन्त); fire.
वेशस in यज्ञ-वेशस, q. v.
वेशि, in astronomy = φάσις.

वेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a dress, dressed, assuming
a particular dress or form; [cf. सर्व-व्˚.]

वेश्मन्, अ, n. a house, dwelling, abode, mansion; a
palace; N. of the fourth astrological house.
—वेश्म-
कर्मन्, अ, n. house-building.
—वेश्म-कलिङ्ग,
अस्, m. ‘house-kaliṅga,’ a kind of sparrow (= च-
टक).
—वेश्म-कूल, अस्, m. a kind of creeper (=
चचेण्डा).
—वेश्म-नकुल, अस्, m. the musk rat or
shrew.
—वेश्म-भू, ऊस्, f. building-ground, ground
suitable for a house, the site of a habitation.
—वेश्म-
स्थूणा, f. the main post or column of a house.

वेश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be entered, to be occupied,
accessible; (अम्), n. a habitation, abode, (Sāy. on
Ṛg-veda VI. 61, 14 = प्रवेशन); the habitation
of harlots; (आ), f. a courtezan, harlot, prostitute,
(sometimes written वेष्या); the plant Cissampelos
Hexandra; a particular metre.
—वेश्या-गण, अस्, m.
a company of harlots.
—वेश्या-गमन, अम्, n.
going after prostitutes, debauchery.
—वेश्या-गामिन्,
ई, m. one who visits prostitutes, a whoremonger.
—वेश्या-गृह, अम्, n. ‘harlot-house,’ a brothel.
—वेश्याचार्य (˚या-आच्˚), अस्, m. the master or
keeper of prostitutes or dancing girls, &c.; a pimp; a
catamite.
—वेश्या-जन, अस्, m. a courtezan.
—वेश्या-
जन-समाश्रय, अस्, m. a habitation of courtezans,
brothel.
—वेश्या-पण, अस्, m. reward or wages
given to a harlot.
—वेश्या-पति, इस्, m. the husband
of a courtezan.
—वेश्या-वार, अस्, m. a number or
company of harlots.
—वेश्याश्रय (˚या-आश्˚), अस्,
m. a habitation of harlots, abode of courtezans.

वेष्य, अस्, m. water [cf. वेष्प]; (आ), f. a
courtezan, harlot, (for वेश्या.)
वेष्य वेष्य. See under वेष, p. 966.

वेशर वेशर, अस्, m. (also written वेसर,
q. v.), a mule.

वेसर वेसर, अस्, m. a mule, (also written
वेशर.)
वेश्वर, अस्, m. a mule.
वेश्वर वेश्वर, अस्, m. See वेशर above.

वेशवार वेशवार, अस्, m. = वेसवार, a kind
of condiment or seasoning.
वेषवार = वेशवार above.

वेसवार वेसवार, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
विस्), a particular condiment or kind of seasoning (con-
sisting of ground coriander, mustard, pepper, ginger,
spice, &c.; also written वेशवार, वेषवार).

वेशीजाता वेशीजाता, f. a kind of creeper
(= पुत्र-दात्री).

वेषण, अस्, m. the shrub Cassia Sophora, = कास-
मर्द; (आ), f. the plant Flacourtia Cataphracta, =
वितुन्न; (अम्), n. occupation, possession, entrance.

वेष्क वेष्क, अस्, m. (perhaps fr. rt. 2. विष्),
Ved. a noose for strangling a sacrificial victim.

वेष्ट् वेष्ट्, cl. 1. A. वेष्टते, विवेष्टे,
वेष्टिष्यते, वेष्टितुम्, to surround, en-
close, encompass, envelop, encircle, wind or twist round
or about, wrap round; to dress: Caus. वेष्टयति,
यितुम्, Aor. अविवेष्टत् and अववेष्टत्, to surround,
encompass; to twist about; to invest, blockade: De-
sid. विवेष्टिषते: Intens. वेवेष्ट्यते, वेवेष्टि.

वेष्ट, अस्, m. surrounding, enclosing; an enclosure,
[]
fence; a turban; a kind of knot (Ved.); exudation,
gum; resin in general; turpentine.
—वेष्ट-वंश,
अस्, m. a sort of bamboo, Bambusa Spinosa.
—वेष्ट-
सार, अस्, m. turpentine (= श्री-वेष्ट).

वेष्टन, अम्, n. the act of surrounding or en-
compassing or enclosing or encircling, (अङ्गुलि-व्˚,
that which invests or encircles the fingers, a finger
ring); grasping; anything that surrounds or encom-
passes; an envelope, wrapper; an enclosure, fence,
wall; a turban, garland, tiara, diadem; a girdle; a
bandage, band; a covering, case; the outer ear
(i. e. the meatus auditorius and concha); a particular
attitude in dancing, (either a disposition of the hands
or crossing of the feet); bdellium.
—वेष्टन-वेष्-
टक, अस्, m. a particular attitude of the sexes in
coitus.
वेष्टनक, अस्, m. a particular position in coitus.

वेष्टनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be surrounded or en-
closed, to be wrapped or wound round.
वेष्टयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, surrounding, encompassing.

वेष्टयित्वा, ind. having bound round, having
encompassed.

वेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, encompassed,
enclosed, encircled, enveloped, bound or wound
round, wrapped up; dressed; invested; impeded,
stopped, blocked, secured from access; (अम्), n. en-
compassing, encircling; one of the gestures or atti-
tudes of dancing, (a particular motion of the fingers
or a crossing of the feet.)

वेष्टितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be surrounded or
encompassed, &c.
वेष्ट्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = वेष्टितव्य above.
वेष्प वेष्प, अस्, m. water; [cf. वाष्प.]
